title: Debug console
description: An on-page panel that shows console errors, warnings and (optionally) logs, for debugging where devtools are not available.

showErrors.description: Show console errors. On by default; `showErrors="false"` hides them.
showErrors.visualReason: Filters which console messages appear; an empty panel looks the same.

showWarnings.description: Show console warnings. On by default; `showWarnings="false"` hides them.
showWarnings.visualReason: Filters which console messages appear; an empty panel looks the same.

showLogs.description: Also show console.log messages. Bare attribute.
showLogs.visualReason: Filters which console messages appear; an empty panel looks the same.

maxMessages.description: Messages kept before the oldest is dropped.
maxMessages.visualReason: Only matters once the panel holds that many messages.

position.description: Corner of the viewport the panel sits in.
